scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @easyinsights/contracts && npm run build -w @easyinsights/core
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,outbox,consumer -c auto "npm run dev -w @easyinsights/web" "WORKER_MODE=outbox npm run dev -w @easyinsights/worker" "WORKER_MODE=consumer npm run dev -w @easyinsights/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @easyinsights/web && npm run build -w @easyinsights/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @easyinsights/web && npm run typecheck -w @easyinsights/worker
scripts.bootstrap: npm run indexes && npm run topics && npm run seed
scripts.compose:logs: docker compose logs -f web outbox consumer
